titleEn: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
summary: The night before Shiganshina, the squad eats, checks the serum, and speaks the basement aloud. At dawn they ride for Wall Maria.

segments.titleEn: The meal of the night before
segments.ja: 奪還作戦の夜、班は同じ卓で飯を食います。食う顔は、訓練の騒がしさを少し戻します。戻すサシャが肉を狙い、ジャンが止め、コニーが笑います。笑う卓の端に、エレンの鍵があります。鍵を、彼らはついに隠さず話題にします。話題は、明日シガンシナの家を開ける、です。開ける家が、この飯の本当の皿です。皿の上で、海の話も一度だけ出ます。
segments.en: On the night of the operation to retake the wall, the squad eats at the same table. The faces that eat bring back a little of the noise of training. Sasha, who brings it back, aims at the meat, Jean stops her, and Connie laughs. At the edge of the laughing table is Eren's key. They finally make the key a topic without hiding it. The topic is: tomorrow we open the house in Shiganshina. The house they open is the real plate of this meal. On the plate, the talk of the sea also comes out only once.

segments.ja: アルミンは、地下室の先に海があるかもしれない、と言います。言う海は、壁の外の無知の反対です。反対を、エレンは父の頁のさらに先として聞きます。聞く先は、明日の戦闘の目標ではありません。目標は、穴と、家です。家のあとで、海はご褒美のように置かれます。置かれたご褒美を、ミカサは生存の条件より下に置きます。下に置くことが、前夜の現実です。食卓の端で、誰かがもう一度杯を置きます。置いた音が、夜の長さを測ります。
segments.en: Armin says there may be a sea ahead of the basement. The sea he says is the opposite of the ignorance outside the walls. Eren hears the opposite as still further ahead of his father's page. The ahead he hears is not the goal of tomorrow's fight. The goal is the hole, and the house. After the house, the sea is set like a reward. Mikasa sets the reward that was set below the condition of survival. Setting it below is the reality of the night before. At the edge of the table, someone sets a cup down once more. The sound of setting it measures the length of the night.

segments.ja: リヴァイは、ケニーの注射をこの夜、班の前で一度だけ見せます。見せる理由は、誰かが死にかけたとき、巨人の力を移す選択がある、です。ある選択を、彼は自分が持つと言います。言う負担は、友人の遺品です。遺品の使用は、まだ決まっていません。決まっていない一本が、卓の空気を重くします。重くしたあと、彼らは再び肉の話に戻します。戻すことが、前夜の作法です。
segments.en: On this night, Levi shows Kenny's injection once, in front of the squad. The reason he shows it is that when someone is about to die, there is a choice to move a Titan's power. He says the choice that is there is one he holds. The burden he states is a friend's remains. The use of the remains is not yet decided. The one undecided vial makes the air of the table heavy. After it makes it heavy, they return again to the talk of meat. Returning is the manner of the night before.

segments.ja: この遠征は、秘密の抜け出しではありません。ヒストリアの命令です。命令は、ウォール・マリアを奪還し、地下室を開け、報告せよ、です。せよ、という公の言葉が、班の夜を合法にします。合法の中でも、死ぬ確率は高いです。高い確率を、エルヴィンは名簿の上で隠しません。隠さない夜を、兵士は自分の意志で乗ります。乗る意志が、偽の王の時代との差です。
segments.en: This expedition is not a secret slipping out. It is Historia's order. The order is: retake Wall Maria, open the basement, and report. The public words of that doing make the squad's night legal. Even inside the legal, the probability of dying is high. Erwin does not hide the high probability on the roster. Soldiers ride the night he does not hide by their own will. The will to ride is the difference from the era of the false king.

segments.ja: ハンジは、雷槍の前の新しい対巨人装備を荷物に加えています。加える装備は、まだ名前を街には出しません。出さない武器を、彼女は鎧と超大型に向けるつもりです。向けるつもりを、モブリットが点検します。点検する手が、前夜の静かな仕事です。仕事の隣で、彼女はエレンの硬質化が壁の穴に使えるかを再確認します。再確認は、実験の失敗の続きです。続きを、明日の現場が試します。地図の折り目が、灯の下で白いです。白い折り目を、指がもう一度追います。
segments.en: Hange is adding to the luggage a new anti-Titan gear from before the thunder spears. The gear she adds does not yet put its name out into the city. She intends to aim the weapon she does not put out at the Armor and the Colossal. Moblit checks the intention of aiming. The hand that checks is the quiet work of the night before. Beside the work, she reconfirms whether Eren's hardening can be used on the wall's hole. The reconfirmation is a continuation of the experiment's failure. Tomorrow's scene will test the continuation. The fold of the map is white under the lamp. A finger follows the white fold once more.

segments.en: Sasha treats the meat of the night before like a last meal. Jean says the treating is unlucky. She denies the unlucky thing he says while eating. The laugh that denies scatters the squad's fear a little. The scattered fear has not vanished. Without vanishing, Connie tells the story of the village only once. The story he tells is that he does not want to see a similar emptiness at Shiganshina. The table receives the wish of not wanting, in silence.

segments.ja: ミカサは、エレンの装備を自分のより先に見ます。見る順序は、前夜も変わりません。変わらない順序を、彼はもう拒みません。拒まないことが、信頼です。信頼の中で、彼女は死ぬな、とは言い切りません。言い切らない代わりに、刃の緩みを直します。直す手が、言葉より長いです。長い手が、明日の行軍の準備です。血清の箱は、机の端に戻されます。戻された箱を、皆が一度見ます。
segments.en: Mikasa looks at Eren's gear ahead of her own. The order of looking does not change on the night before either. He no longer refuses the order that does not change. Not refusing is trust. Inside the trust, she does not say flatly: do not die. Instead of saying it flatly, she fixes a loose blade. The hand that fixes is longer than words. The long hand is the preparation of tomorrow's march. The box of the serum is returned to the edge of the desk. Everyone looks once at the box that was returned.

segments.ja: エルヴィンは、夜の端で名簿を閉じます。閉じる前に、彼は新兵の顔を一度見ます。見る顔の多くは、明日が初めての壁の外です。外の作戦は、穴を塞ぎ、敵の待ちを割り、家に入る、です。入る家が、彼個人の知りたい頁でもあります。ある頁を、彼は演説では強調しません。しない代わりに、生存の手順を繰り返します。繰り返す声が、前夜の最後の命令です。
segments.en: At the edge of the night, Erwin closes the roster. Before closing it, he looks once at the recruits' faces. For many of the faces he looks at, tomorrow is the first time outside the walls. The operation outside is: plug the hole, split the enemy's waiting, and enter the house. The house they enter is also a page he personally wants to know. He does not emphasize the page that is there in a speech. Instead of emphasizing it, he repeats the procedure of survival. The voice that repeats is the last order of the night before.

segments.ja: アルミンは、シガンシナの図を卓に広げます。広げる図は、穴と、家と、敵が先にいる可能性です。可能性は、獣と、鎧と、超大型です。三つの名を、彼は前夜に隠しません。隠さない図を、班は飯のあとで見ます。見る顔は、訓練の図より静かです。静かな理由は、今度は仮説ではなく、明日の地面だからです。地面の上に、地下室の印が小さくあります。夜の風が、天幕の布を一回だけ揺らします。揺らした風のあと、会話は続きます。
segments.en: Armin spreads the diagram of Shiganshina on the table. The diagram he spreads is the hole, the house, and the possibility that the enemy is there first. The possibility is the Beast, the Armor, and the Colossal. He does not hide the three names on the night before. The squad looks at the diagram he does not hide, after the meal. The faces that look are quieter than the diagrams of training. The reason they are quiet is that this time it is not a hypothesis. It is tomorrow's ground. On the ground, the mark of the basement is small. The night wind shakes the tent cloth only once. After the wind that shook it, the talk continues.

segments.ja: エレンは、キースの話のあとでも、父の頁を閉じていません。閉じていない頁を、彼は明日開くと言います。言う声は、特別な英雄の声ではありません。母の普通の息子が、鍵を使う声です。使う鍵を、ヒストリアの命令が支えています。支えていることを、彼は卓で一度確認します。確認が、罪の骨を公の仕事に変えます。変えた仕事を、班は一緒に持ちます。
segments.en: Even after Keith's story, Eren has not closed his father's page. He says he will open tomorrow the page he has not closed. The voice he says it in is not the voice of a special hero. It is the voice of his mother's ordinary son using the key. Historia's order is supporting the key he uses. He confirms once, at the table, that it is supporting it. The confirmation changes the bone of sin into public work. The squad holds together the work it changed.

segments.ja: ジャンは、前夜に翼のマークを磨きます。磨く理由は、マルコに見せるためではありません。明日、自分の位置から逃げないためです。ための決意を、彼は大きな言葉にはしません。しないまま、サシャの肉を最後にもう一度取り上げます。取り上げる騒がしさが、恐怖の蓋です。蓋の下で、彼はシガンシナの地図を見ます。見る街が、訓練で選んだ答えの本番です。出発前の点検は、刃の数を声に出します。出した数が、列の準備の終わりです。
segments.en: On the night before, Jean polishes the mark of the wings. The reason he polishes it is not to show Marco. It is so that tomorrow he does not run from his own position. He does not make the resolve of that purpose into large words. Without making it, he takes Sasha's meat away one last time. The noise of taking it away is a lid on fear. Under the lid, he looks at the map of Shiganshina. The city he looks at is the real performance of the answer he chose in training. The check before departure says the number of blades aloud. The number that was said is the end of the line's preparation.

segments.ja: 飯が終わると、リヴァイは注射を再び外套へ戻します。戻す動作を、班は見ています。見ている誰も、自分がその一本の対象だとは言いません。言わない沈黙が、前夜の最も重い秒です。重い秒を、兵長は短く切ります。切る言葉は、使うときは自分が決める、です。決める負担を、友人の死がすでに彼に渡しています。渡された負担で、彼は眠ります。眠る前に、刃の位置だけを見ます。
segments.en: When the meal ends, Levi returns the injection to the coat again. The squad is watching the motion of returning it. No one who is watching says that they are the object of that one vial. The silence of not saying it is the heaviest second of the night before. The Captain cuts the heavy second short. The words of cutting are: when it is used, I decide. The death of a friend has already passed him the burden of deciding. With the burden that was passed, he sleeps. Before sleeping, he looks only at the place of the blades.

segments.ja: 夜が終わると、馬が門に並びます。並ぶ列は、ウォール・マリアへ向きます。向く方向は、落ちた壁の穴です。穴の奥に、エレンの家があります。ある家を、女王の命令と個人の鍵が同時に指します。指す朝に、サシャはまだ肉の味を覚えています。覚えている味が、生きて帰る理由の小さい版です。小さい理由を、班は恥ずかしいとは言いません。門の前で、馬が足を一度踏み変えます。踏み変えた音が、夜の最後の合図です。
segments.en: When the night ends, horses line up at the gate. The column that lines up faces Wall Maria. The direction it faces is the hole of the fallen wall. Beyond the hole is Eren's house. The queen's order and a personal key point at the house that is there, at the same time. On the morning they point, Sasha still remembers the taste of the meat. The taste she remembers is a small version of the reason to come back alive. The squad does not say the small reason is embarrassing. In front of the gate, a horse shifts its feet once. The sound of the shift is the last signal of the night.

segments.ja: 奪還作戦の夜は、戦いそのものではありません。戦いの前に、飯を食い、鍵を言い、注射を見て、地図を閉じる時間です。時間の終わりに、彼らは兵士として門を出ます。出る門の向こうは、友人の定義が削られる場所です。削られることを、前夜はまだ全ては知りません。知らないまま、列は夜明けに動きます。動く音が、季節の後半の開始です。
segments.en: The night of the operation to retake the wall is not the fight itself. It is the time, before the fight, of eating, saying the key, seeing the injection, and closing the map. At the end of the time, they leave the gate as soldiers. Beyond the gate they leave is a place where the definition of friend will be shaved. The night before does not yet know all of the shaving. Without knowing, the column moves at dawn. The sound of moving is the start of the second half of the season.
